profile.headline: Software Engineer with a diverse background across multiple disciplines

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Helping to keep the world moving

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built mechanism for automatically importing user setting data.

Facilitated refactoring of codebase to handle Ipv6 protocols on machine learning user behavior analytics platform.

Wrote team protocols for the deployment of a centralized repository for profiles and connectivity configurations.

Setup and maintained development Kubernetes clusters for development and testing.

Assigned and monitored tasks to my development team for IBM WatsonX Challenge including prompt-driven coding (Gen AI).

Used Kafka in a Java environment to handle incoming security events in the form of Kafka messages for a custom rules engine. 

Collected and analyzed data in clusters using Openshift, Prometheus and Grafana metrics
Used container engines for local testing and development and AWX clusters for integration testing. 
Performed enhancement tests by changing parameters (# of CPUs, pods, threads) in containers.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Quarkus · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Databases · Kafka Streams · RESTful WebServices · Python (Programming Language) · OpenShift · JavaScript · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Aided in the port of the digital coaching messaging service from Node.js to Java.

Designed, developed, implemented, and maintained the coach appointment scheduling service in Java. This service uses data stored in Salesforce Apex to populate calendars and allow end-users to a timeslot of an appointment. Coaches are chosen for a given time slot based on factors such as availability, sponsorship, and expertise.

Moved appointment computations out of Salesforce and into an in-memory mechanism to speed up computations and lower the cost of using Salesforce.

Aided in the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of a notification service (including DB tables) for push notifications to the Sharecare app.

Performed bug fixes and service enhancements for member tagging (Node.js). This service used various properties of members to determine which programs they would qualify for and properly tag them as such.

Was responsible for writing QA tests and staging all services I interacted with for testing and release through our own homebrew pipeline.

“Picked up” ownership of a critical service when a co-worker left suddenly. With very little documentation I was tasked with understanding how this service worked and how to interact with obfuscated personally identifiable information to fix existing flaws in the production data.
Responsible for test cases for all of my code that were provided to the QA team.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Databases · RESTful WebServices · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed and implemented backend services and middleware in Java and .NET that allowed legacy systems to interact with a new WebUI.  All web services were specified using either Swagger for Java applications or Swashbuckle for .NET applications.  

Designed, developed and implemented a Security Service that acts as the gate keeper to the new Web UI.  It is designed to work with legacy privileges and user tables and was specified using Swashbuckle.

Used Enterprise Architect to design multiple web services and tools for internationalization.

Designed, developed and implemented an internationalization mechanism for installations with Java.  This allows the Web UI to change dynamically between English and any localized language with provided translations on demand.

Developed Python scripts for internationalization code generation.  Legacy configuration files were used to generate Java classes that allow all localized resource files to be checked during installation for any missing translations.

Designed SQL tables with Enterprise Architect for maintaining Web UI user information.  Tables were designed with the capability to interact with both legacy and new systems.

Refactored existing web services to use SSL and WSS connections in the same manner that new services were being developed with SSL.

Used Wireshark to capture and diagnose intersection controller communication issues.

Developed and defined milestones and timelines for a multi-year connected vehicle government project.

Used Enterprise Architect to design database tables and sequence diagrams to address inter-process communication issues for the New York traffic center connected vehicle project.

Designed and implemented a module for receiving SNMPv1 and SNMPv3 communications from proprietary hardware.

Performed ASN.1 data manipulation, encoding (as UPER) storing and transmission.

Worked with hardware manufacturers to determine connected vehicle hardware specifications.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Databases · Swagger API · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
This position performed new development as well as bug fixing and porting of legacy software.

Was responsible for both front and back-end development.  This included modifications to the user interface and server-side development for message processing.

The application received signals in the 1553 message standard and parsed those.

Used C# to develop new modules for D.O.D. client software.

Ported existing C++ software modules into C# for D.O.D. clients.  This included designing classes that enabled captured messages to be easily passed from module to module.

Used Viso to design UML layouts of proposed software design.

Used MKS Integrity and GIT (with Tortoise GIT and Atlassian interfaces) source code repository for all projects.

Held D.O.D. security clearance

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new modules for the company’s flagship ERP product.  This required client side development using a combination of C# and WPF and also required server side development utilizing C# and SQL databases queries.  

Performed user interface development which utilized the View Models functionality of WPF XAML which was bound to data models constructed using C#.  

Designed and wrote queries in both SQL Server and Oracle that populated the C# data models.

Identified and resolved defects in C# code using the Visual Studio debugger and, at times, setting up local hosts on the development machine to run both client and server modules in the same environment.

Developed a high visual contrast interface for the same ERP platform.

Worked with the TFS source code and work items systems.

Collaborated daily with a development team in Shanghai over a 4 month period.  Limited availability of common work hours required efficient and complete communication techniques.

positions.title: Industry Analyst
positions.description:
Industrial B2B research utilizing qualitative and quantitative teamsConducted qualitative in-depth interviews for primary and secondary research.

Used qualitative and quantitative data to construct market models and recommend go-to-market strategies.

Writing proposals for qualitative, quantitative and both qual and quant studies for prospective clients.

Final report construction for clients.

In-field in-depth interviews and competitive intelligence at conferences and site visits.

Projects completed in oil & gas, petrochemical, food safety, private security, industrial flooring, industrial safety, wastewater/disposal, industrial chillers.

Given in-person final presentation to COO and VP of $700M a year company

General IT support and media conversion of files from interviews and focus groups.

I am familiar with the B2B landscape, including the major players and industry trends.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Edited TV commercials for a digital sign system used in airport retail shops with Adobe Premier Pro.

Implemented internet delivery of commercials to digital sign systems.

C++ and Atmel assembly language evelopment.

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Linux:  My primary work machine was a Linux box.  My supervisor, understanding the importance of the operating system, forced me to learn it the hard way, disabling the GUI for the first several weeks of my employment until I could work out of the command line sufficiently.  As a result I became very adept at customizing Linux systems and, as a result, customizing the user interfaces.

Python:  I was involved in the design and implementation of a program that used a an array of cameras to track a subject's motion based on LED tracking.
iOS:  I was part of a project to help develop an iPhone interface for elderly, visually impaired users.  Unfortunately funding was pulled from the project before its completion
Android:  The blind interface phone project started on Android, but a decision higher up was made to move to the iPhone.

Subject interaction and study administration:  While I did not think this would be overly challenging at first, interacting with and administering a study protocol with a blind subjects made me realize how much I relied on physical demonstration and interaction to describe a process.  I had to hone my verbal description skills and raise them to a new level in order to describe the testing environment to those would could not see it.

Study design

IT:  The IT at the VA was somewhat slow in responding to problems (through no fault of the IT guys, the rad tape involved with having anything upgraded or replaced was considerably thick).  I was often asked to come up with temporary solutions to hold out until IT eventually got around to us.

positions.title: Post Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Proposed and received a Presidential Undergraduate Research Award (PURA) for developing a monitoring system to determine occupancy and position of patients in hospital beds to prevent pressure ulcers; wrote a Visual Basic program to give a graphical representation of subject orientation and record raw voltages from pressure sensors and output them in an Excel format allowing the data to be easily represented in charts.

Integrated three existing products to develop a camera that could be easily assembled by quadriplegics that allowed them to take pictures and upload them to a computer; developed software to change camera position based on voice commands using voice recognition software.

Instrumented wheelchairs with data logging devices to track wheelchair usage statistics, such as occupancy, location, and seat tilt position; performed maintenance on data logging equipment.

Tested wheelchair cushions with force loading equipment to simulate up to 5 years of usage to ultimately develop cushions that reduced the incidence of pressure ulcers; fabricated equipment to allow pressure sensor data to be received by recording software.

Evaluated and selected lasers for the wound measurement device to serve as a quick diagnostic tool.

Attended 2008 RESNA conference and represented various CATEA products and studies.
